written: 2026-11-18, before any baseline was run on eAP queries and before any comparison
question: Zero-shot Overall MiD of published optical-expansion / motion-in-depth methods given our RGB endpoint pair and supplied boxes, on a fixed subset of public TRAIN40 queries, versus our OOF heads and classical box estimators.

OEXP.paper: Yang & Ramanan, Upgrading Optical Flow to 3D Scene Flow through Optical Expansion, CVPR 2020

settings.normalization: submission.py: BGR, /255 minus mean of mean_L

SFPP.native_output: dchange = Z2/Z1 in image-1 coordinates, clamped to [0.5, 1.5]

RAFT_AFF.rho: least-squares affine x2 = M x1 + c on region pixel centres, refit on the 80% smallest residuals; rho = -0.5 log|det M|

TPCV.reason: requires compiling the custom CUDA extension inverse_cuda (and alt_cuda_corr); superseded by ScaleFlow++ from the same authors

BiTTC.license: NVIDIA Source Code License (non-commercial research/evaluation only, NVIDIA processors only)
BiTTC.reason: Python 3.6 / PyTorch 1.6 environment, fixed 384x1152 crop and a 72-scale x 97-shift sweep per pair: incompatible with the shared crop and the GPU budget

subset.population: 88,744 public TRAIN40 queries (data/train.parquet joined with annotations/train.parquet, pinned SHA-256)
subset.allocation: proportional to band counts within each sequence, largest remainder, ties in order c,s,l,n
subset.sampling: sorted sample_token within (sequence, band), permuted with numpy.random.default_rng([20261120, k]) where k is the sequence position in the sorted sequence list (one generator per sequence, bands in order c,s,l,n); first n taken
subset.reduction_rule: if the timing pilot projects more than 3.2 GPU hours, reduce per_sequence and take prefixes of the same permutations

input.pair: the two frames of the row (frame_timestamps_us), expected [t-100 ms, t]; image1 = query frame t, image2 = frame t-D
input.crop: common square centred on the union of both boxes (edge coordinates [x1, x2+1)), side = max(union width, union height, 8) * 1.5, resampled to 384x384 with Pillow BILINEAR, outside pixels 0
input.region: crop pixels whose centre lies inside the query-frame box

conversion.failure: non-finite rho or empty region -> rho = 0, counted

aggregation.primary: median over region (RAFT_AFF: trimmed affine fit over region)
secondary: median over inner box (central 50% width and height)

calibration.fit: for each held-out block B0..B4: weighted median of phi/phi_hat with weights w_i |phi_hat_i|, w_i = band weight / training-block band count; rows with phi_hat = 0 excluded

synthetic_zoom.criterion: median rho_hat monotone decreasing in sigma and correct sign for sigma != 1

sanity_checks.author_sample: CSCV 000019_10.png / 000019_11.png (KITTI, forward camera motion), forward order, expect log(Z2/Z1) < 0 over most of the scene for OEXP and SFPP; report median and inter-method correlation
